blurb: Guests play an 18-hole par 3 golf course with holes ranging from 75 to 152 yards. The course features grass tee boxes, bent grass greens, sand bunkers on holes 5, 6, and 13, and a water hazard on hole 6. The facility includes a pavilion with snacks and beverages, and offers lessons and club rentals.
extraNote: Open all year from 7am to dusk · Night Golf tournaments held twice a year, dates announced on calendar · All year
